visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of article teaser cards (photo, topic tag, date, title, summary, read time) linking to article pages

contentPattern.structure: one row per article: image | body. Body order: tag paragraph, date paragraph, title heading (linked to the article), summary, optional read time ("6 min"). The title link, or the first link, covers the whole card

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of articles or insights linking to detail pages. For product or category cards use cards-product; for tools use cards-tool.
